name: Inari Amertron Berhad
overview: 今年公司终止了与 Sanan Optoelectronics 联合收购 Lumileds International 的计划，未新增或出售任何业务板块。其余公告主要为股息、股东大会及董事会委员会人事变动，没有涉及产能扩张、新合约或业务缩减的披露。
overview_en: During the year, the company terminated the proposed joint acquisition of Lumileds International with Sanan Optoelectronics. No new business segments were added or divested. Other announcements mainly covered dividends, general meetings and board committee changes, with no disclosures on capacity expansion, new contracts or business downsizing.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年集团层面终止了一项拟议的联合收购，未涉及现有业务板块的运营变动。
segments.note_en: At group level, a proposed joint acquisition was terminated this year; no operational changes to existing business segments were disclosed.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司宣布于 2026 年 4 月 30 日签署两份终止协议，正式结束上述联合收购。
actions.text_en: The company announced that two termination agreements were entered into on 30 April 2026 to formally conclude the termination of the proposed joint acquisition.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司与 Sanan Optoelectronics Co., Ltd 及 Lumileds Subholding B.V. 于 2026 年 4 月 17 日同意终止联合收购 Lumileds Holding B.V. 及其部分子公司 100% 股权的计划。
actions.text_en: The company, together with Sanan Optoelectronics Co., Ltd and Lumileds Subholding B.V., agreed on 17 April 2026 to terminate the proposed joint acquisition of 100% equity interest in Lumileds Holding B.V. and certain of its subsidiaries.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 公司终止拟联合收购 Lumileds International 的计划，未完成该项业务拓展。
model_changes.text_en: The company terminated the proposed joint acquisition of Lumileds International, and the business expansion was not completed.
